items.stem: A mixer receives 100 kg/h of a stream and 50 kg/h of a second stream at steady state with no reaction. What is the mass flow of the single outlet?

options.rationale: Correct: at steady state with no reaction, mass in equals mass out, so 100 + 50 = 150 kg/h.
This ignores the first inlet stream.
This ignores the second inlet stream.
Mass flows add; they are not multiplied.

items.stem: For an ideal gas held at constant temperature, if the absolute pressure doubles, the volume will:

options.rationale: Correct: at constant temperature, pressure and volume are inversely proportional (Boyle's law).
Volume falls, not rises, when pressure increases at constant temperature.
Volume changes inversely with pressure at constant temperature.
The relationship is inverse and linear, not a fourfold increase.

items.explanation: Correct: at constant temperature, pressure and volume are inversely proportional (Boyle's law).
